title: Lemon Tahini Dressing
style: Creamy, tangy tahini dressing with lemon, garlic, and a touch of maple.
description: A smooth, drizzleable lemon tahini dressing whisked together in five minutes—perfect over salads, bowls, and roasted vegetables.
steps: In a small bowl, whisk together the tahini, water, lemon juice, olive oil, maple syrup, sesame oil, garlic, and salt until smooth.
If the dressing is too thick, add more water, 7 g (½ tbsp) at a time, until it reaches a drizzleable consistency.
tips: Use a smooth, runny tahini—thick or bitter tahini will need extra water and a little more maple syrup to balance.
Keeps in an airtight jar in the fridge for up to 5 days; it thickens when chilled, so whisk in a splash of water before serving.
Great over the High-Protein Vegan Salad, grain bowls, or roasted vegetables.
